notes.title: Ver. 1.0.4.0 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h3]Version 1.0.4.0 Update Details:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Updated some art assets.
[*] Increased backpack capacity.
[*] Fixed some incorrect text and translations.
[*] [Phoebe’s Chapter] [spoiler]Fixed an issue where flipping pages in the Book of Leviathan using the controller’s joystick acted abnormally.[/spoiler]
[*] [Phoebe’s Chapter] [spoiler]Adjusted the playback mechanism for the CG video in the living room.[/spoiler]
[*] [Tommy’s Chapter] [spoiler]Adjusted the mechanism of the translucent goldfish in The Shore.[/spoiler]
[*] [Yonny’s Chapter] [spoiler]Picking up the ladder in the 1F corridor will no longer place it in the backpack.[/spoiler]
[*] [Yonny’s Chapter] [spoiler]Rearranged the dialogue choices before entering the ending.[/spoiler]
[*] [Yonny’s Chapter] [spoiler]Fixed an issue where Levi summoned using the 1F corridor telephone would not target the player.[/spoiler]
[*] [Yonny’s Chapter] [spoiler]Fixed an issue where if Yonny was killed by Levi while holding the ladder, she would be unable to enter Tommy’s room.[/spoiler]
[/list]
